paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Challah, chapter 4, as having brought firstborn animals up from Babylonia, but they were not accepted from him. Hyman reports that the Matnita of the Westerners reads ben Atatam.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Matnita of the Westerners reading is attributed to Hyman; no new collation is claimed.

The whole Torat Emet Mishnah Challah 4:11 scalar has Ben Antinos bringing firstborn animals from Babylonia and their not being accepted. The supplied heading Ben Antigonus remains beside that distinct digital spelling. The Matnita of the Westerners’ ben Atatam reading remains Hyman’s report, not a freshly collated variant or new identity. The existing mixed note is preserved verbatim and no additional cases from the paragraph are imported.
